svg.title: Private networking and DNS
svg.desc: Service traffic follows the subnet route. DNS resolves names; it does not proxy application connections.

g.text: Service traffic follows the subnet route. DNS resolves names; it does not proxy application connections.
Split DNS for the lab zone
IPv4 egress NAT on the host
DHCP pool: 10.205.234.100 to 10.205.234.200; stable reservations for service and node names.
DHCP supplies router 10.205.234.1 and DNS 10.205.234.2. Static addresses stay outside that pool.
Incus DNS and DHCP are disabled. Guests return tailnet traffic through their default gateway.
Internal guests use OpenSSH; Tailscale SSH terminates on the Incus host.
Instance addressing is IPv4-only. Host firewall rules and Tailscale ACLs enforce access; Incus bridge firewalling is off.
